hypothesis: Many encoder runs hit the iteration cap; continuing them may improve training without improving held-out predictions. Distinguish convergence from capability.
design: Continue selected35 checkpoints for diagonal_wave/cos_product,5 seeds,400 additional iterations,unchanged objective/bounds. Original128 train/256 validation retained; test on an entirely new1024-point cohort.
selection: Keep previous checkpoint unless validation loss improves; never select on new test. Log training/validation per iteration and final optimizer status.
limits: Targeted convergence diagnostic, not matched optimization budget or new algorithm. Smaller loss is not automatically better generalization.
